goal: Read docs/IDEA.md with no history and write docs/BRIEF.md: what this round asks for.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/BRIEF.md has the sections Asked, Deliverable, Done when, Unclear and Not asked
It restates only what docs/IDEA.md says

decisions.what: Brief treats the round as seven fix-ups followed by two new app types (R4 Monitoring, R5 Survey), not as a new project
decisions.why: The idea says part 1 fix-ups come first, part 2 adds apps, and earlier work and branding are kept
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md L3 'FIX-UPS (do first)', L11 'NEW APPS', L18 'Keep everything the earlier rounds built'

decisions.what: Product type left unstated in Deliverable
decisions.why: The idea names no product kind, only its features and docs

decisions.what: Trends and zero baselines on line charts listed under Not asked
decisions.why: The idea says trends off and zero baseline is for bars only
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md L16 'trends off'; L8 'zero baseline is bars only'

assumptions: T, N and C are column-type counts (presumably temporal, numeric, categorical); flagged under Unclear, not relied on
